title: Attestation
description: A third-party signed statement about a business, seller, or physical Location, carried as a compact JWS Trust Mark ([RFC 7515](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7515)).

type.description: Reverse-domain attestation type identifier owned by the issuer's domain. MUST equal the signed `trust_mark_type` claim inside `token` so verifiers can filter candidate attestations before decoding tokens or fetching issuer keys.

token.description: Compact JWS ([RFC 7515](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7515)) carrying protected header `typ: 'ucp-attestation+jwt'`, asymmetric `alg`, and `kid`, and an OpenID Federation Trust Mark payload (`#/$defs/claims`) signed by a key published at `iss`.

status_list.title: Status List Reference
status_list.description: Pointer to a revocation entry inside an IETF Token Status List (`draft-ietf-oauth-status-list`).

idx.description: Zero-based index of this attestation's status entry in the referenced Status List Token.

uri.description: HTTPS URL of the issuer's signed Status List Token.

status.title: Attestation Status
status.description: Revocation status reference carried in the `status` JWT claim.

status_list.description: Token Status List reference identifying the list URI and bit index for this attestation.

claims.title: Attestation Claims
claims.description: Decoded JWT payload of a UCP attestation token, profiled from OpenID Federation 1.0 Trust Marks. Issuers MAY include additional top-level claims defined by `trust_mark_type`.

iss.description: HTTPS URL of the issuer's key document (`/.well-known/ucp` or `/.well-known/jwks.json`, unless explicitly pinned by verifier policy). Its host MUST satisfy Authority Binding for `trust_mark_type`.

sub.description: Canonical HTTPS `/.well-known/ucp` profile URL of the subject business, seller, or host, matched as an exact string.

trust_mark_type.description: Reverse-domain attestation type identifier. MUST equal the enclosing entry's `type`.

iat.description: Issuance time in seconds since the Unix epoch.

exp.description: Expiration time in seconds since the Unix epoch. Required in UCP.

nbf.description: Optional not-before time in seconds since the Unix epoch.

logo_uri.description: Optional HTTPS URL of the issuer's visual mark for display.

ref.description: Optional HTTPS URL of a human-readable certificate or verification page for this attestation.

location_id.description: Physical Location identifier (`Location.id`) when the attestation is scoped to a single branch. Forbidden on `business_summary.json` (`dev.ucp.common.business` and `sellers` entries) and REQUIRED (MUST equal `Location.id`) on `Location.attestations[]`.

seller_id.description: Seller key in a response `sellers` map when the attestation is scoped to a marketplace seller or regional entity bound to the host's profile URL (`sub`) rather than a standalone seller profile URL. Forbidden on profile-level `dev.ucp.common.business` and `Location.attestations[]`.

status.description: Optional revocation status pointer using an IETF Token Status List.
